scientific_question: Does the off-diagonal coupling in the active-ray transverse-sensitivity tensor repair the sole five-camera temporal failure that scalar-axis weighting did not repair?
role: post-open private controlled-proxy geometry-coupling diagnostic; not a learned method, not true experimental pairing, and not a deployment or resource result
physical_hypothesis: The remaining sparse-view error may be governed by coupled world-axis directions rather than three independent axis sensitivities. The full active-ray transverse tensor retains those couplings in one fixed quadratic H1 form.

v160.interpretation: half-order smoothing worsened all five-camera tails

v161.interpretation: diagonal inverse-axis sensitivity is insufficient; post-hoc diagonal weight and multiplier tuning are closed

source_semantics.density_output: first TorchScript output is the reconstructed density field; require finite values only and apply no clipping or offset
source_semantics.synthetic_pairing: camera-field pairing and two-component observations are generated by code for the controlled proxy; no true experiment pairing is inferred
source_semantics.source: direct clarification from the supervising senior on 2026-08-18

inputs.models: the same nine CPU-adapted TorchScript models sealed by v157-v161
inputs.calibrations: the same thirteen nine-camera JSON files sealed by v157-v161

representation.field_subspace: zero-mean DCT 16x8x8 excluding the constant coefficient
representation.ray_source: the unit world-frame ray directions that enter the frozen forward for each active camera and 24x24 detector target grid
representation.transverse_sensitivity_tensor: S = mean over active cameras and rays of (I - d d^T), symmetrized before eigendecomposition
representation.coupling_tensor: W = U diag(1 / max(eig(S), 1e-12)) U^T, where S = U diag(eig(S)) U^T
representation.derivative_discretization: the same numpy.gradient edge_order=2 derivative on the frozen physical axes used by the gradient metric
representation.reduced_quadratic: R = B^T G^T (W tensor I_voxels) G B, assembled independently from separable one-dimensional orthonormal inverse-DCT factors and their frozen finite-difference derivatives
representation.constant_mode: assemble all 16x8x8 modes, then remove the unique (0,0,0) row and column
representation.primary_normalization: symmetrize R and divide by the median of its 1023 strictly positive eigenvalues
representation.comparison_penalties: the frozen v161 diagonal geometry H1 and v159.1 isotropic H1 penalties, each with its original median-one normalization
representation.permutation_contract: reordering active cameras or rays cannot change S, W, R, or the reconstructed field beyond 1e-12 relative
representation.variable_cardinality: S, W, and R are rebuilt separately from the fixed 5-, 7-, and 9-camera active sets
representation.forbidden_variants: no diagonal replacement, central-ray substitute, learned tensor, alternative matrix function, tensor rotation, shrinkage, off-diagonal scaling, alternative eigenvalue floor, clipping, alternative normalization, alternate multiplier, or per-sample selector

regularization.origin: held identical to v159-v161 after median-eigenvalue normalization of the full reduced quadratic; not selected from v162 results

metrics: p50/p90-higher/worst by time, arm, and camera count
S and W eigenvalues, off-diagonal energy, and reduced-quadratic spectrum by calibration and camera count

cost_accounting.geometry_setup: 1023 exact nine-camera A-equivalent basis projections per calibration; all camera subsets, arms, models, and times reuse sealed geometry
cost_accounting.geometry_tensor_construction: geometry-only 3x3 reductions plus a fixed 1023x1023 reduced quadratic eigensystem per setup; zero A and zero A-transpose, but dense setup wall and memory are not treated as free
cost_accounting.primary_online_after_geometry_cache: one exact reduced A-transpose equivalent for B^T y and one exact reduced A equivalent for the final projection
cost_accounting.resource_claim: forbidden until a later fresh-process wall and whole-pipeline RSS gate

independent_recomputation.physics: rebuild camera rays and sparse operators with the independent v156 numerical path
independent_recomputation.basis: analytic cosine products rather than scipy multidimensional idctn basis construction
independent_recomputation.geometry_tensor: explicit scalar accumulation of I-d d^T over independently reconstructed active rays, followed by scipy.linalg.eigh
independent_recomputation.reduced_quadratic: assemble from explicit independently differentiated analytic one-dimensional cosine factors and Kronecker products; do not import the formal tensor or quadratic helpers
independent_recomputation.eigensolver: scipy.linalg.eigh with a Cholesky-based generalized solve rather than the formal explicit inverse-square-root whitening
required_comparisons: all 39 S/W tensors and reduced-quadratic audits
the frozen v161 diagonal and H1 control rows and summaries

decision_order: Any input, source-semantics, operator, basis, ray, tensor, reduced-quadratic, density, stationarity, residual, accounting, historical-control, permutation, or independent-recomputation failure makes v162 inconclusive.
Only W=S^{-1}, the frozen physical finite-difference reduced quadratic, and multiplier 0.03 are primary; no alternative may replace them after results.

The primary passes only if every one of the twelve time-by-camera strata passes all absolute gates, each nine-camera stratum satisfies parent no-harm, and the formerly failed t=0.75 five-camera gradient p90 is strictly lower than the frozen H1 value.
A valid failure closes the current family of global quadratic geometry-anisotropy mechanisms and does not authorize tensor tuning, a larger model, or GPU rescue.

A valid pass establishes only controlled-proxy temporal reference adequacy and authorizes a separately frozen minimal CPU observation-only predictor diagnostic; it is not real BOST, external generalization, or a resource result.
